Project Objective¶

The main objective of this project is to analyze the Zomato sales data using Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) techniques in Python, with the goal of uncovering hidden insights that can aid different departments and managers in making datadriven decisions. The analysis will focus on understanding sales patterns, customer behaviors, regional performance, and product/service performance to provide actionable insights for better decision-making within the organization

Data Cleaning and Preprocessing: • Handle missing data, duplicates, and outliers. • Convert relevant data columns (such as dates, numerical values, and categorical variables) into the correct format. • Standardize and normalize data if necessary. Sales Performance Analysis: • Analyze overall sales trends over time (monthly, quarterly, yearly). • Identify the best-performing regions, branches, and product categories. • Explore sales based on time of day, day of the week, and seasonal variations.

plt.figure(figsize=(40,30))
for i,j in enumerate(ls2):   
    plt.subplot(4,4,i+1)
    df3=df2[j].value_counts().head(10)
    row=df3.shape[0]
    x=df3.index
    y=df3.values
    if row <=1:
        plt.hist(y)
        plt.title(f'Distribution of {j}')        
    elif row<=5:
        plt.pie(x=y , labels=x, autopct='%0.2f%%')
        plt.title(f'Distribution by {j}')
    else:
        plt.bar(x,y,color=sns.color_palette('cool',10)) 
        plt.title(f'Comparison')
        plt.xticks(rotation=35)
plt.savefig("D:\Dashboard\ZAMOTO.jpg")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(25,30))
for i,j in enumerate(ls2):
    plt.subplot(4,4,i+1)
    df3=df2[j].value_counts().head(10)
    rows=df3.shape[0]
    x=df3.index
    y=df3.values
    if rows<=1:
        plt.hist(df3.values)
        plt.title(f'Distribution analysis of {j}')
    elif rows<=5:
        plt.pie(x=y, labels=x)
        plt.title(f'Distribution analysis by {j}')        
    else:
        color=np.random.choice(["cool", 'magma'])
        plt.bar(x,y , color=sns.color_palette(color,10))
        plt.title('Comparsion')
        plt.xticks(rotation=25)
